title: Aeronautics Museum of Maracay

terrainReference.basis: Independent public elevation at the photographed gate approach on the low west side of the site.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Museo Aeronáutico site and building outlines
mapIdentity.scope: Public Aeronautics Museum grounds at the former Maracay airfield in September 2021, including the public entrance gate, pavilion and the mapped museum gallery and hangar buildings.

note: The named native museum perimeter separates the historic public museum from the rest of the airfield. The 2021 images establish the approach, pavilion ornament and the structure of the hangar bays. Terrain is held independently.
